milestones.title: Open-source readiness audit
milestones.description: Public-repo audit mirroring the completed ponderousdev/foreman open-sourcing process (plan of record: ponderousdev/foreman#35): history + conversation + shipped-content scans, workflow/fork hardening, Apache-2.0 relicense, free security features, permanent guards. Already public, so findings are remediations with rotation urgency.

milestones.title: Dev flow v2
milestones.description: Dev flow v2 — determinism thesis: reviewer + integrator agents return schema-validated evidence to the session-as-orchestrator; exit and rendering computed by script from round JSON; config in .devflow.toml + agent registry. Anchor spec: specs/dev-flow-v2.md (this repo); lifecycle vocabulary in docs/product/domain.md and docs/glossary.md (stages implement → verify → challenge → review → security → integration; "gauntlet" and "shepherd" are retired names; skills /implement /review /integrate + /orchestrator; agents implementer/challenger/reviewer/integrator). Sibling milestones: evanharmon1/harmon-init "Dev flow v2" ([rounds]/[breadth]/[gates]/[convergence]/[role]/[stage] template, AGENTS.md shrink, pre-PR gate) and ponderousdev/foreman "Dev flow v2" (consume the shared contracts — envelope v2, .devflow.toml keys, round JSON, run record — in Foreman's own Python). Out of scope: orchestrator agent, new review-product integrations, Foreman's supervision loop, a dedicated fixer role, readiness-gate conditions. In scope since 2026-08-31: parallel implementers ([stage.implement] pool + council distinct_families) and the challenger role. Settled in the 2026-08-28 grill session, revised in the 2026-08-31 config design session (decision record: harmon-init#1081).

milestones.title: Issue classification
milestones.description: Classify issues by impact, risk, and complexity (issue fields on orgs, labels on personal repos), derive the model tier from risk × complexity, retire suggest:* and Size. Design record: the epic issue in evanharmon1/harmon-init.

milestones.title: Integration convergence
milestones.description: Apply the local stages convergence rules to the integration stage: end it after two consecutive cycles with zero adjudicated P0/P1, record a scaffolding checkpoint from cycle 2, and enforce both in the exit engine rather than by memory. Consolidates the six earlier requests (harmon-init #1329; harmon-devkit #1073, #1160, #1179, #1201, #1240).

milestones.title: Orchestrator resilience
milestones.description: Make orchestrated slates survive restarts and unattended waits: shipped lane provisioning, plan mutation, promotion and finder-pass recording (#1523); lane-watch prompts, stalls and heartbeat (#1517) with operating rules (#1518); fewer agy approval stops (#1519); herdr agy detection (#1520); and the run-record and reporting follow-ups from slate epic-1357.

milestones.title: Standardize-repo fleet runs
milestones.description: Make /standardize-repo a fleet-wide, wave-ordered, herdr-orchestrated run with a fixed start-of-run question set, a GitHub-side reconcile phase, scoped reviews and issue-backed reports. ADR: docs/decisions/2026-10-26-fleet-standardization-runs.md; spec: specs/standardize-repo-fleet.md.
